item.text: {"ticker":"UBER","status":"success","report":"This report is for educational use only and is not financial advice. MCP returned an FCFF valuation for Uber Technologies, Inc. with estimated value per share of $93.68 versus a market price of $71.82. Growth assumes revenue growth of 14.81% in years 2-5, stepping down toward 4.6% terminal growth; the mapped growth anchor is Software (System & Application), United States, 2026, with high confidence. Margins move from a 10.0% next-year operating margin toward a 19.32% target operating margin. Reinvestment is modeled through sales-to-capital of 4.01x in years 1-5 and 2.01x in years 6-10, so valuation sensitivity depends heavily on how efficiently new revenue converts into capital needs. Cost of capital starts at 10.05% and fades to 9.63%; the terminal value is $445.42B before discounting, with present value of terminal value of $107.74B. Data caveats: Yahoo Finance coverage can be missing, stale, or insufficient for some companies; rates are shown in percent; sales-to-capital is shown as an x multiple; and single-lever market expectation checks solve one variable at a time while all other assumptions stay fixed."}
